evidence.title: SK Hynix maintains HBM market leadership with 50% share in 2026
evidence.summary: SK Hynix HBM market share 2026: 50% of global HBM bit output (down from 59% in 2025), compared to Samsung 28% and Micron 22%. Source basis: global HBM bit output share, not unit share.
evidence.excerpt: SK hynix is projected to lead global HBM bit output with a 50% share—down from 59% in 2025—while Samsung's portion climbs from 20% to 28%.

evidence.title: Samsung HBM production capacity expansion to 250k wafers/month by end 2026
evidence.summary: Samsung HBM production capacity: ~250k wafers/month by end 2026 (47% increase from 170k wafers). Current capacity 170k wafers/month as baseline. Source basis: wafer-level production capacity, not finished units.
evidence.excerpt: Samsung aims to boost HBM production to around 250,000 wafers per month by the end of 2026—a roughly 47% increase from the current 170,000 wafers.

evidence.title: Micron HBM4 production ramp Q2 2026 with 15k wafers/month target
evidence.summary: Micron HBM4 production ramp: Q2 2026 volume start, capacity target ~15k wafers/month in 2026, with calendar 2026 supply fully booked. Source basis: wafer-level capacity, ramp timeline.
evidence.excerpt: Micron plans to lift HBM4 capacity to 15,000 wafers per month in 2026. Micron has already locked in pricing and volume agreements covering its entire calendar 2026 HBM supply.

evidence.title: HBM total market capacity exceeds 30 billion Gb in 2026
evidence.summary: HBM total market capacity 2026: >30 billion Gb bits across all suppliers (SK Hynix, Samsung, Micron). Source basis: total bit capacity shipment forecast, not unit capacity or wafers.
evidence.excerpt: Total HBM shipments are forecasted to exceed 30 billion Gb in 2026.

evidence.title: SK Hynix M15X Cheongju fab ramping 40k wafers/month by 2H 2026
evidence.summary: SK Hynix M15X fab in Cheongju: initial output 10k wafers/month with expansion planned. Latest guidance indicates 40k wafers/month capacity by 2H 2026. Source basis: fab-level wafer capacity.
evidence.excerpt: SK hynix plans to start 1b DRAM production for the latest HBM4 at M15X in February, with initial output expected at ~10,000 wafers per month, with capacity set to expand multiple times by the end of 2026.

evidence.title: SK Hynix completes 12-high hybrid bonding HBM validation, yields improving
evidence.summary: HBM stack assembly yield: SK Hynix has completed validation of 12-high hybrid bonding HBM stacks and is working to raise yields for mass production. Hybrid bonding eliminates micro-bumps, enabling higher stacks. Source basis: qualitative yield improvement status, not quantitative yield percentage.
evidence.excerpt: SK hynix has reportedly completed 12-high hybrid bonding HBM validation, working to raise yields for mass production.

evidence.title: Hanmi Semiconductor TC bonder first deliveries 2H 2026 for HBM4/HBF
evidence.summary: HBM stacking equipment lead time: Hanmi Semiconductor TC (thermo-compression) bonders for HBM/HBF first deliveries expected 2H 2026. Equipment suppliers (ASMPT, Hanmi, BESI, K&S) all competing with similar 6-12 month lead times. Source basis: equipment delivery timeline, not historical constraint data.
evidence.excerpt: Hanmi Semiconductor is preparing to deliver its first batch of HBF TC bonders to customers in the second half of 2026, and is viewed as being furthest along in development.

evidence.title: Advantest ATE test equipment lead times exceed 6 months in 2026 for HBM
evidence.summary: HBM test equipment (ATE) lead time: Advantest semiconductor test equipment average lead times exceed 6 months as of Jan 2026 for HBM and GPU applications. Source basis: equipment availability constraint metric.
evidence.excerpt: As demand strengthens in markets such as GPUs and high-bandwidth memory (HBM), Advantest's orders for semiconductor automated test equipment (ATE) remain stable, with average product lead times exceeding six months.

evidence.title: SK Hynix orders HBM4 TC bonders from ASMPT as equipment lead times remain tight
evidence.summary: HBM bonding equipment suppliers: SK Hynix actively sourcing from multiple suppliers (ASMPT, Hanmi) for TC bonders due to capacity constraints. ASMPT supplies roughly half of SK Hynix's ~50 TC bonder units in use. Source basis: supplier concentration and equipment utilization.
evidence.excerpt: SK hynix has placed a new order for thermal compression (TC) bonders with Singapore-based ASMPT to support HBM4 manufacturing. Currently, SK hynix is using about fifty sets of TC bonders for HBM4 production, with roughly half supplied by ASMPT.

evidence.title: Samsung HBM4 initial market share projected mid-20% for 2026
evidence.summary: Samsung HBM market share 2026: HBM4 initial shipments starting post-Lunar New Year 2026 with mid-20% initial share projection. Combined HBM3E + HBM4 share climbing to ~28% by end 2026. Source basis: product-generation-specific market share forecast.
evidence.excerpt: Samsung HBM4 shipment start after Lunar New Year with initial share projected at mid-20%.
